arguments.command:
printf "\r\n📦 Updating composer packages...\n" &&
termy_say -s "Updating composer dependencies" &&
OUTPUT_TXT=$(composer update 2>&1) &&
printf "%s\n\n" "$OUTPUT_TXT" &&
if echo "$OUTPUT_TXT" | grep -q "Nothing to modify"; then
 termy_say -s "All php packages are already up to date";
else
 termy_say -s "Composer update completed";
fi
